lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li4Cd4Au4 (reduced formula LiCdAu) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom: Cd and Au each coordinate to 4 Au/Cd and 8 Li, while Li coordinates to 8 Au/Cd and 4 Li, at neighbor distances of 2.74–2.89 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Cd and Au polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Li and the other polyhedra.
